title: ns3-advanced-networking-suite: Experimental Artifacts and Trace-Driven Simulation Models for Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency Networking

creators.name: Chandel, Vishal
creators.affiliation: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, Jawaharlal Nehru Government Engineering College (JNGEC), Sundernagar, India

description:
Comprehensive simulation models, hardware data planes (Linux eBPF & Intel Tofino P4_16), industrial trace replays, and reproducibility suites across three advanced networking research projects:
1. DualBP-AQM: Burst-Aware Coupled Active Queue Management for L4S (RFC 9332).
2. SADS-MAC: Wi-Fi 6 (IEEE 802.11ax) Multi-User OFDMA Deadline & Airtime Deficit Scheduling.
3. CGPS-RPL: Congestion-Gradient Predictive Steering for Ultra-Reliable Bursty Industrial 6LoWPAN Networks.
